female.sp: RGM-96Xs Jesta (Shezarr Team Type), B & C Team equipment from Mobile Suit Gundam Narrative. The attached model-kit photographs are authoritative mechanical design references; the combined front/rear product image controls the exact armor, capture gun and shield geometry, while the second image reinforces the backpack and rear silhouette. Preserve the deep midnight-navy and blue-gray armor palette, pale desaturated blue upper arms and thighs, two light rectangular chest plates, small white shin and skirt accents, orange visor slit, and the distinctive pale-blue multi-sensor frame wrapping around the helmet sides and crown. Keep both broad angular shoulder plates, thick forearm guards, layered knee and shin armor, and large squared feet mechanically intact. Preserve the compact central backpack with exactly TWO downward thruster bells and the articulated mounting arm that carries ONE large elongated dark shield behind and along her LEFT side. Her RIGHT hand holds exactly ONE B/C-team capture gun: a long heavy rectangular dark-gray barrel with a cylindrical muzzle, small side sensor and the paired curved silver conduits near the rear grip. Keep the right forearm equipment blocks and waist grenade racks visible without multiplying them. The open fitted armor may expose the collarbones, narrow waist sides and controlled upper-thigh gaps between plates, but never remove the shoulder armor, forearm guards, shins, backpack, shield or primary weapon. Her human face is fully visible with exactly two natural amber eyes; do not replace it with an opaque visor or Gundam mask. Translate the orange visor and sensor identity into a narrow amber sensor-brow ornament plus pale-blue temple frames around, not across, the face. Keep the complete head sensor, both shoulders, capture gun, shield, backpack thrusters and both feet fully inside the vertical frame. No text, logos, unit numbers, watermark or pilot resemblance.
